verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

Approved. The watchdog now routes its idempotent GitHub GET reads through the shared bounded-retry layer while leaving issue/label mutations on the existing single-attempt transport. Retry exhaustion and unread or malformed populations still propagate as AlarmError/rc=2 rather than becoming healthy defaults. The lazy path load preserves the thin-checkout cron-map consumer, and the watchdog sparse checkout plus REQUIRED_FILES/YAML-seam assertions carry and pin the helper on the live path. The added tests are non-vacuous at the subprocess boundary: they count real gh attempts and backoffs, distinguish transient 503 from permanent 404 and invalid JSON, verify the actual argv is read-scoped, and assert both recovered and persistently failed whole-tick exit codes. No trust check, permission boundary, credential handling, or audit binding is weakened.
